title: DPYC Supported Nostr Relays
description: Schema for the DPYC federation's single source of truth for Nostr relays (relays.json). Array order is preference order; the first entry (or the one flagged primary) is the Secure Courier's first rendezvous try.

order_policy.description: How membership of this list changes, as distinct from ranking. Stated here because the two are easy to conflate: rank is a measurement, membership is a commitment.

caveat.description: What a reader must know before trusting the measurements — chiefly that reachability depends on where it was measured from.

primary.description: True for the courier's first rendezvous try. At most one relay should set this.

notes.description: Free-form rationale — why this relay is on the supported list.
